subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic server-side compaction be exposed as provider-specific model parameters on the existing Anthropic integration, rather than as a new generic agents.defaults.compaction mode?
rationale: The choice determines the durable public configuration contract and whether local compaction remains the default coexistence behavior; source evidence shows no existing Anthropic-native equivalent to extend mechanically.

options.title: Use provider-scoped model parameters
options.body: Add an opt-in Anthropic-specific parameter contract with explicit direct-route eligibility and preserve the current local compaction default.

options.title: Add a generic compaction mode
options.body: Introduce a provider-neutral compaction mode only after defining how every provider, fallback, transcript, and plugin contract interprets it.

options.title: Defer to beta passthrough
options.body: Keep generic beta-header passthrough only until maintainers are ready to own compaction-block persistence and user-facing configuration.

recommendation.title: Use provider-scoped model parameters
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in Anthropic-specific parameter contract with explicit direct-route eligibility and preserve the current local compaction default.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history and the existing review discussion place this person closest to the affected Anthropic and compaction decision surfaces.
